en: Luke 2

p.src: 1  Now in those days, a decree went out from Caesar Augustus that all the world should be enrolled.

en: Now in those days, a decree went out from Caesar Augustus that all the world should be enrolled.
u.src: 1  Now in those days, a decree went out from Caesar Augustus that all the world should be enrolled.

p.src: 2  This was the first enrollment made when Quirinius was governor of Syria.

en: This was the first enrollment made when Quirinius was governor of Syria.
u.src: 2  This was the first enrollment made when Quirinius was governor of Syria.

p.src: 3  All went to enroll themselves, everyone to his own city.

en: All went to enroll themselves, everyone to his own city.
u.src: 3  All went to enroll themselves, everyone to his own city.

p.src: 4  Joseph also went up from Galilee, out of the city of Nazareth, into Judea, to David’s city, which is called Bethlehem, because he was of the house and family of David,

p.src: 5  to enroll himself with Mary, who was pledged to be married to him as wife, being pregnant.

en: to enroll himself with Mary, who was pledged to be married to him as wife, being pregnant.
u.src: 5  to enroll himself with Mary, who was pledged to be married to him as wife, being pregnant.

en: While they were there, the day had come for her to give birth.
u.src: 6  While they were there, the day had come for her to give birth.

p.src: 7  She gave birth to her firstborn son. She wrapped him in bands of cloth and laid him in a feeding trough, because there was no room for them in the inn.

en: She gave birth to her firstborn son. She wrapped him in bands of cloth and laid him in a feeding trough, because there was no room for them in the inn.

zh: 天使報喜訊給牧羊的人

p.src: 8  There were shepherds in the same country staying in the field, and keeping watch by night over their flock.

en: There were shepherds in the same country staying in the field, and keeping watch by night over their flock.
u.src: 8  There were shepherds in the same country staying in the field, and keeping watch by night over their flock.

p.src: 9  Behold, an angel of the Lord stood by them, and the glory of the Lord shone around them, and they were terrified.

en: Behold, an angel of the Lord stood by them, and the glory of the Lord shone around them, and they were terrified.
u.src: 9  Behold, an angel of the Lord stood by them, and the glory of the Lord shone around them, and they were terrified.

p.src: 10  The angel said to them, “Don’t be afraid, for behold, I bring you good news of great joy which will be to all the people.

en: The angel said to them, “Don’t be afraid, for behold, I bring you good news of great joy which will be to all the people.
u.src: 10  The angel said to them, “Don’t be afraid, for behold, I bring you good news of great joy which will be to all the people.

p.src: 11  For there is born to you today, in David’s city, a Savior, who is Christ the Lord.

en: For there is born to you today, in David’s city, a Savior, who is Christ the Lord.

en: 2:11 “Christ” means “Anointed One”.

p.src: 12  This is the sign to you: you will find a baby wrapped in strips of cloth, lying in a feeding trough.”

en: This is the sign to you: you will find a baby wrapped in strips of cloth, lying in a feeding trough.”
u.src: 12  This is the sign to you: you will find a baby wrapped in strips of cloth, lying in a feeding trough.”

p.src: 13  Suddenly, there was with the angel a multitude of the heavenly army praising God and saying,

en: Suddenly, there was with the angel a multitude of the heavenly army praising God and saying,
u.src: 13  Suddenly, there was with the angel a multitude of the heavenly army praising God and saying,

p.src: 14  “Glory to God in the highest, on earth peace, good will toward men.”

en: “Glory to God in the highest, on earth peace, good will toward men.”
u.src: 14  “Glory to God in the highest, on earth peace, good will toward men.”

p.src: 15  When the angels went away from them into the sky, the shepherds said to one another, “Let’s go to Bethlehem, now, and see this thing that has happened, which the Lord has made known to us.”

en: When the angels went away from them into the sky, the shepherds said to one another, “Let’s go to Bethlehem, now, and see this thing that has happened, which the Lord has made known to us.”
u.src: 15  When the angels went away from them into the sky, the shepherds said to one another, “Let’s go to Bethlehem, now, and see this thing that has happened, which the Lord has made known to us.”

p.src: 16  They came with haste and found both Mary and Joseph, and the baby was lying in the feeding trough.

en: They came with haste and found both Mary and Joseph, and the baby was lying in the feeding trough.
u.src: 16  They came with haste and found both Mary and Joseph, and the baby was lying in the feeding trough.

p.src: 17  When they saw it, they publicized widely the saying which was spoken to them about this child.

en: When they saw it, they publicized widely the saying which was spoken to them about this child.
u.src: 17  When they saw it, they publicized widely the saying which was spoken to them about this child.

p.src: 18  All who heard it wondered at the things which were spoken to them by the shepherds.

zh: 凡聽見的，就詫異牧羊之人對他們所說的話。
en: All who heard it wondered at the things which were spoken to them by the shepherds.
u.src: 18  All who heard it wondered at the things which were spoken to them by the shepherds.

p.src: 19  But Mary kept all these sayings, pondering them in her heart.

en: But Mary kept all these sayings, pondering them in her heart.
u.src: 19  But Mary kept all these sayings, pondering them in her heart.

p.src: 20  The shepherds returned, glorifying and praising God for all the things that they had heard and seen, just as it was told them.

en: The shepherds returned, glorifying and praising God for all the things that they had heard and seen, just as it was told them.

p.src: 21  When eight days were fulfilled for the circumcision of the child, his name was called Jesus, which was given by the angel before he was conceived in the womb.

en: When eight days were fulfilled for the circumcision of the child, his name was called Jesus, which was given by the angel before he was conceived in the womb.

u.src: 23  (as it is written in the law of the Lord, “Every male who opens the womb shall be called holy to the Lord”),

p.src: 24  and to offer a sacrifice according to that which is said in the law of the Lord, “A pair of turtledoves, or two young pigeons.”

en: and to offer a sacrifice according to that which is said in the law of the Lord, “A pair of turtledoves, or two young pigeons.”

p.src: 25  Behold, there was a man in Jerusalem whose name was Simeon. This man was righteous and devout, looking for the consolation of Israel, and the Holy Spirit was on him.

en: Behold, there was a man in Jerusalem whose name was Simeon. This man was righteous and devout, looking for the consolation of Israel, and the Holy Spirit was on him.
u.src: 25  Behold, there was a man in Jerusalem whose name was Simeon. This man was righteous and devout, looking for the consolation of Israel, and the Holy Spirit was on him.

p.src: 26  It had been revealed to him by the Holy Spirit that he should not see death before he had seen the Lord’s Christ.

en: It had been revealed to him by the Holy Spirit that he should not see death before he had seen the Lord’s Christ.
u.src: 26  It had been revealed to him by the Holy Spirit that he should not see death before he had seen the Lord’s Christ.

en: 2:26 “Christ” (Greek) and “Messiah” (Hebrew) both mean “Anointed One”

p.src: 27  He came in the Spirit into the temple. When the parents brought in the child, Jesus, that they might do concerning him according to the custom of the law,

en: He came in the Spirit into the temple. When the parents brought in the child, Jesus, that they might do concerning him according to the custom of the law,
u.src: 27  He came in the Spirit into the temple. When the parents brought in the child, Jesus, that they might do concerning him according to the custom of the law,

p.src: 28  then he received him into his arms and blessed God, and said,

en: then he received him into his arms and blessed God, and said,
u.src: 28  then he received him into his arms and blessed God, and said,

p.src: 29  “Now you are releasing your servant, Master, according to your word, in peace;

en: “Now you are releasing your servant, Master, according to your word, in peace;
u.src: 29  “Now you are releasing your servant, Master, according to your word, in peace;

p.src: 30  for my eyes have seen your salvation,

en: for my eyes have seen your salvation,
u.src: 30  for my eyes have seen your salvation,

p.src: 31  which you have prepared before the face of all peoples;

en: which you have prepared before the face of all peoples;
u.src: 31  which you have prepared before the face of all peoples;

p.src: 32  a light for revelation to the nations, and the glory of your people Israel.”

en: a light for revelation to the nations, and the glory of your people Israel.”
u.src: 32  a light for revelation to the nations, and the glory of your people Israel.”

p.src: 33  Joseph and his mother were marveling at the things which were spoken concerning him.

en: Joseph and his mother were marveling at the things which were spoken concerning him.
u.src: 33  Joseph and his mother were marveling at the things which were spoken concerning him.

p.src: 34  Simeon blessed them, and said to Mary, his mother, “Behold, this child is appointed for the falling and the rising of many in Israel, and for a sign which is spoken against. 35  Yes, a sword will pierce through your own soul, that the thoughts of many hearts may be revealed.”

zh: 西面給他們祝福，又對孩子的母親馬利亞說：「這孩子被立，是要叫以色列中許多人跌倒，許多人興起；又要作毀謗的話柄，叫許多人心裏的意念顯露出來；你自己的心也要被刀刺透。」
en: Simeon blessed them, and said to Mary, his mother, “Behold, this child is appointed for the falling and the rising of many in Israel, and for a sign which is spoken against.
Yes, a sword will pierce through your own soul, that the thoughts of many hearts may be revealed.”
